# Token Maker

> Token Maker is a browser-based VTT token maker for DnD, Roll20, Foundry VTT, and similar tabletop workflows. It helps users upload character art, crop portraits, apply token masks and borders, add labels, and export transparent PNG tokens.

Token Maker is designed for tabletop creators, game masters, players, and content publishers who need practical virtual tabletop tokens. The normal editor workflow is local-first: portrait images can stay in the browser during crop, style, and export.

The site has English pages at root-level URLs and Simplified Chinese pages under `/zh`. Use `sitemap.xml` for the full indexable URL set and `robots.txt` for crawler access rules. Do not treat this file as permission to access disallowed paths such as `/api/`.

## Core Pages

- [Token Maker home](https://www.tokenmaker.one/): Main browser editor and English overview for creating VTT tokens.
- [Token Maker Chinese home](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh): Simplified Chinese version of the main editor and overview.
- [DnD dice roller](https://www.tokenmaker.one/dice-roller-dnd): Browser dice roller for DnD stat rolls, common dice presets, roll logs, and tabletop use.
- [DnD dice roller Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/dice-roller-dnd): Simplified Chinese version of the DnD dice roller.
- [Square token maker](https://www.tokenmaker.one/templates/square-token-maker): Square VTT token workflow for grid maps, 1:1 crops, borders, and transparent PNG export.
- [Square token maker Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/templates/square-token-maker): Simplified Chinese square token maker workflow.
- [FAQ](https://www.tokenmaker.one/faq): Questions about image handling, workflow fit, supported token styles, and export size.
- [FAQ Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/faq): Simplified Chinese FAQ.
- [Privacy](https://www.tokenmaker.one/privacy): Privacy information, including the local-first image workflow.
- [Contact](https://www.tokenmaker.one/contact): Public contact form for site feedback and support requests.

## Blog And Guides

- [Blog index](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog): English DnD, VTT token, and tabletop workflow articles.
- [Blog index Chinese](https://www.tokenmaker.one/zh/blog): Simplified Chinese article index.
- [DND Classes Explained](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-classes-explained): Guide to choosing DnD classes.
- [DND Armor Guide](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-armor-guide): Armor types, AC values, and class picks.
- [DND Counterspell Guide](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-counterspell): Counterspell timing, 2014/2024 rules, and FAQ.
- [DND Necromancer Spells](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-necromancer-spells): Spell list and minion-management guidance for necromancer play.
- [mephistopheles dnd: Cania's Archdevil, Pact Traps, and DM Hooks](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/mephistopheles-dnd): Archdevil lore, Cania, pact traps, and DM encounter hooks.
- [dnd bard spells: Best Picks for Support, Control, and Social Play](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-bard-spells): Bard spell picks by role, cantrips, control, healing, social magic, concentration, and VTT prep.
- [dnd demons: Types, Devils Difference, and DM Encounter Guide](https://www.tokenmaker.one/blog/dnd-demons): Demon type reference, demons vs devils, Abyss encounter design, VTT token tips, FAQ, and companion video.
